goal: Give every pull request a disjoint, generation-keyed agent evidence path (#2708) and refuse an evidence pair anchored to a superseded base after a refresh (#2845), without relaxing any evidence standard and without breaking the approval carry-forward rule.
dispatcher: Owner Albert Hazan authorized resolving all open non-orchestrator issues in this repository
prohibited_actions: No database write, migration, function, view, role, grant, index, or timeout change.
Do not relax any evidence standard; this changes the filename, never the standard.
Do not exempt .agent files from conflict resolution, freeze main during reviews, or relax the exact-head review rule.

Do not touch another session's uncommitted work in this worktree (scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs, scripts/run-governed-review.mjs and scripts/lib/reviewer-caller-env.mjs carry issue #2678 work that is not mine).
required_checks: node --test on every changed scripts test file
assumptions: The legacy fixed evidence pair stays valid, so no open pull request is forced to rewrite its evidence and trigger the very re-review storm #2708 exists to stop.
The published contract is immutable, so the current merge base is recorded by the completion report rather than by republishing the contract at a new generation.
This contract was published before any commit existed on this branch; the working tree held the change and nothing had been committed.
stop_conditions: Stop if resolving either issue would require relaxing the exact-head approval rule or the .agent/ exclusion that carries an APPROVE across a refresh.
Stop if a backwards-compatible path cannot be kept for pull requests that already carry the legacy pair.
